title: S06T01 - Define the agent adapter manifest and capability registry
description: Model instruction roots, skill formats, MCP config, hooks, ignore rules, command aliases, context limits, lifecycle operations, and platform support in one schema-backed registry.
acceptanceCriteria: The manifest can describe Codex, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot, Windsurf, Roo/Cline, Kiro, VS Code MCP, and generic AGENTS.md clients.
Install plans, doctor checks, documentation, and upgrade actions are generated from the same registry.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
